t_advice_summary_textbox.text: red brown purple pink gnomes lead to red basket. Yellow orange blue and green gnomes lead to yellow basket. Each baskets supply lowers after you pick it. if you pick one that is 0 or 1 mushroom, switch basket

vb_textbox.text: There are two coloured baskets that are revealed to you on the second page after choosing a gnome. If you select the yellow, blue, green or orange gnomes, you will receive the yellow basket. If you select the red, brown, purple or pink gnomes you will receive the red basket. You want to stick with selecting the same basket until you receive either 0 or 1 mushrooms from it. If you receive 0 or 1 mushrooms, switch to the other basket going forward. This will maximise your return on mushrooms throughout the game. Remember, stick with the same colour basket UNLESS you get 0 or 1, then switch. Good luck.
